attempts.sql:
WITH production_files AS (
  SELECT f.file_id
  FROM code.files f
  WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
    AND f.directory NOT LIKE '%tests/%'
),
connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         s.qualname,
         s.file_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN production_files p ON s.file_id = p.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.class_bases cb
      WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
        AND cb.base_name = 'SQLDatabase'
    )
),
class_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'method'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
    AND s.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.class_symbol_id,
                  cm.method_name
  FROM class_methods cm
  JOIN connector_classes cc ON cm.class_symbol_id = cc.class_symbol_id
     AND cm.class_symbol_id = cc.file_id  -- method belongs to this class file
),
sqldb_methods AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s2.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
                  s2.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbols s2
  WHERE s2.kind = 'method'
    AND s2.is_public = TRUE
    AND s2.name NOT LIKE '_%'
    AND s2.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
     AND s2.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND name = 'SQLDatabase')
)
SELECT cm.class_symbol_id,
       cm.method_name
FROM connector_methods cm
LEFT JOIN sqldb_methods sm ON cm.class_symbol_id = sm.class_symbol_id
                             AND cm.method_name = sm.method_name
WHERE sm.class_symbol_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cm.class_symbol_id,
         cm.method_name;

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: The query first identifies production (non-test) files, then finds classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase. It collects all public, non-underscore methods defined in those connector classes and subtracts any methods that SQLDatabase itself defines publicly, leaving only methods unique to each connector class.

  SELECT f.file_id
  FROM code.files f
  WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
),
connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         s.qualname,
         s.file_id

  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
